brief: Clear an optional pointer target and record its original identity.
notes: Empty span models null; valid targets use the verified shared pointer-clear behavior.

bookkeeping.scope: Complete original body on supplied synthetic globals, valid images and indices; original ABI checked from bytes and execution. Host memory and original identities are explicit inputs.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Null entries/empty spans where original has a null guard; otherwise valid supplied spans. Invalid host lengths and slots are rejected, not evidence of original fault equivalence.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 16 fresh original-execution cases matched bit-exact by the native runner; self-test registered in ctest. See docs/recovery/cell-comparisons.md.
